name: Admin Document Create
description: Create a new admin document via Markdown paste mode or file upload mode, with title, live preview, and the OPTIONAL client/project association: ClientAutocomplete (doc-client-autocomplete, with inline client creation) plus ProjectSelect (doc-project-select) in allowNoClient mode — picking a project FIRST autofills its owner into the client field (inverse cascade), and the payload always carries client/project (null included). Creating inside a folder whose documents mostly belong to one client pre-fills that client (documents/folder-client-suggestion/, hint doc-client-suggested-hint) — a suggestion, never a lock.
knownGaps: Spec covers paste mode only; "Cargar Archivo" upload mode (POST /api/documents/upload-markdown/), cover toggles and template-style selection untested (2026-07-16 audit).
